# Video & animation

Tools for social clips, talking-head videos, tutorials, captioning, and generative video experiments. Some are full editors with AI helpers; others are generators with limited free credits. The best free choice depends on whether you need control, speed, or a short experimental clip.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **15 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** Get permission before using anyone's face, voice, or private footage. AI video tools may watermark exports, publish projects, or claim broad processing rights. For anything public or commercial, check the license, disclose synthetic media where required, and keep a backup of the original footage.

**Start here:** [CapCut](#tool-capcut) · [DaVinci Resolve](#tool-davinci-resolve) · [Descript](#tool-descript)

## All 15 tools

<a id="tool-capcut"></a>

### CapCut

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free desktop and mobile video editing with templates, auto captions, background removal, and a selection of AI-assisted tools.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account for cloud and AI features; no card expected. Some effects point to Pro at the moment of use.
- **Limits:** Many AI effects, stock assets, higher-quality exports, and advanced controls are Pro-only. Availability, ownership, and data handling vary by region; review ByteDance's current terms.
- **Best for:** Short-form social videos, simple tutorials, and captioned clips with a fast editing workflow.
- **Official link:** <https://www.capcut.com>
- **Tags:** `editing` `captions` `social-media` `templates`

<a id="tool-davinci-resolve"></a>

### DaVinci Resolve

`Free` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A genuinely free professional desktop editor with video editing, color correction, audio mixing, visual effects, and some AI-assisted features.
- **Sign-up notes:** Download the free version from Blackmagic Design; no card. Registration details may be requested.
- **Limits:** DaVinci Resolve Studio adds many Neural Engine features, higher resolutions, and collaboration tools. The free version is large, hardware-hungry, and not beginner-simple.
- **Best for:** Long-term video work where you want industry-grade editing without a subscription.
- **Official link:** <https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/products/davinciresolve>
- **Tags:** `editing` `color` `professional` `desktop`

<a id="tool-descript"></a>

### Descript

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Edit video and audio by editing a transcript, with free transcription minutes, basic recording, and limited AI actions.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Descript account; no card. Transcription and export limits apply.
- **Limits:** Transcription hours, resolution, exports, and advanced features are capped. Some exports carry restrictions, and higher usage or studio features need a paid plan.
- **Best for:** Podcast clips, talking-head videos, and tutorial edits when you prefer working from words.
- **Official link:** <https://www.descript.com>
- **Tags:** `transcription` `podcast` `editing` `captions`

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

<a id="tool-invideo-ai"></a>

### InVideo AI

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Generate a narrated video from a text prompt using stock footage, AI voice, captions, and an editable timeline.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. Weekly AI generation credits and watermarked exports apply.
- **Limits:** The free plan has a small weekly or monthly AI generation allowance, watermarked exports, and limited access to voices and stock. Review stock and voice licensing.
- **Best for:** A fast draft explainer or promotional clip when you want a script-to-video starting point.

<a id="tool-heygen"></a>

### HeyGen

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free avatar and AI presenter videos with a small monthly video allowance and a library of avatars and voices.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. Short, watermarked videos and a small monthly quota apply.
- **Limits:** Free videos are short, watermarked, and limited in number. Custom avatars, longer videos, higher resolution, and commercial features are paid. Use only your own likeness or documented permission.

### Runway

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

<a id="tool-wan-video"></a>

### Wan

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Open-source video-generation models you can run locally, with text-to-video and image-to-video capabilities.
- **Sign-up notes:** Download the official model or code; no account or card. You supply a capable GPU and setup time.
- **Limits:** Very demanding on GPUs, storage, and setup time. Model licenses and acceptable-use terms still apply. Quality and speed depend heavily on hardware and settings.
- **Best for:** Technical users who want local control over generative video experiments.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/Wan-Video/Wan2.2>
- **Tags:** `video-generation` `local` `advanced` `open-models`
